description: Return the hour-by-hour grid carbon intensity forecast for one region, up to 72 hours ahead. Use when: the user asks how clean the grid is now or later, or wants the raw curve. Do not use to pick a run time for a task (use recommend_window) or to queue work (use schedule_task). Behavior: writes nothing; reads one grid feed, no login; GB is live without a key, other zones need a feed key or get synthetic data (Source: mock). Returns: region, source, generated time, one row per hour (gCO2/kWh and band), and the cleanest and dirtiest hour. Rejects an unknown zone and lists the closest zones.

hours.description: How many hours ahead to forecast, e.g. 12 to cover "tonight". Defaults to 24; 72 is the most.

region.description: Grid zone code, e.g. 'US-CAL-CISO', 'GB' or 'DE'; take it from the user's location or the data center they name. `tidegap region list` prints the supported zones; any zone works with an Electricity Maps key. Defaults, where the host lets it be omitted, to the configured region, else the stored setting (`tidegap region set`), else a time-zone guess, else GB.

name: get_grid_forecast
